options.name: Response duration
options.description: Duration of the returned impulse response, in seconds.

options.name: Echogram sample rate
options.description: Sample rate used to compute the echogram (energy response envelope). COMPLETELY UNRELATED TO THE AURALIZATION SAMPLE RATE. Higher values will produce more accurate results, but the decomposition will take longer.

options.name: Auralization sample rate
options.description: Sample rate used to produce the auralization RIR.

options.name: T60 threshold
options.description: The decomposition (in each band) will stop after locating all energy modes with longer reverberation times than this.

options.name: Max slopes
options.description: The decomposition (in each band) will stop after locating this many energy modes, even if the T60 threshold has not been reached.

options.name: Points per square meter
options.description: Density of surface sample points used for the numerical area integration.

options.name: Rays per hemisphere
options.description: Density of sample directions used for the numerical solid angle integration.

options.name: Max parallel processes
options.description: Cap to the number of processes spawned for the numerical integration.
